# Object

The objects of the object store of the fleet, such as a file uploaded with osapi
client file upload. `osapi behavior get --name object` and
`osapi behavior method get` show the same.

## Method get

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Name        | get                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Verb        | read                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Description | Get an object of the object store                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Detail      | Reads the object from the object store of the fleet, with the content type that its upload gave it, raw or template, and the SHA-256 of its content. A template is not rendered: the behavior that deploys it renders it. An agent with no object store reports skipped. |
| Route       | other behaviors only; it is not served                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Input type  | GetInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Output type | Object                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

### Input (1)

| FIELD | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                  | DESCRIPTION                                                                       |
| ----- | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| name  | string | yes      | min length 1, max length 255 | The name of the object, as osapi client file upload stored it, such as nginx.conf |

### Output (4)

| FIELD        | TYPE   | DESCRIPTION                                                   |
| ------------ | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| name         | string | The name of the object                                        |
| content      | string | The content of the object                                     |
| content_type | string | raw, or template for an object whose content is a Go template |
| sha256       | string | The SHA-256 of the content, in hex                            |
